name: SIMEPROP
recent: Sime Darby Property 近期推进多项企业活动：股东在11月3日特别股东大会通过以RM418.5百万收购柔佛古来556.96英亩永久地契土地；同时以RM160百万向PNB收购Wisma UniRazak的买卖协议条件期限延长至2027年2月19日。此外，公司宣布在墨尔本推出总值A$1.08亿的混合用途项目，并传出考虑在2028年前设立REIT上市。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过以RM418.5百万向SD Guthrie Berhad收购柔佛古来约556.96英亩永久地契土地。
公司以RM160百万向Permodalan Nasional Berhad收购Wisma UniRazak的买卖协议条件期限延长三个月至2027年2月19日。
公司在墨尔本推出总值A$1.08亿的混合用途项目，并传出考虑在2028年前设立REIT上市。
risks: 公司有一项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理公告（编号5），但未提供具体细节。
EPF 与 KWAP 在2026年10月至11月期间有多项持股变动申报，显示主要股东持股出现变化。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为RM1,160.6百万，环比增长45.2%，同比增长9.3%；净利为RM322.0百万，环比增长102.8%，同比增长124.4%；净利率为27.7%，高于上一季度的19.9%。

recent_en: Sime Darby Property has recently advanced several corporate activities: shareholders passed the RM418.5 million acquisition of 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor at an EGM on 3 November; the conditional period for the RM160 million acquisition of Wisma UniRazak from PNB was extended to 19 February 2027. The company also launched an A$1.08 billion mixed-use project in Melbourne and is reportedly considering a REIT listing by 2028.
notable_en: Shareholders at an EGM approved the RM418.5 million acquisition of approximately 556.96 acres of freehold land in Kulai, Johor from SD Guthrie Berhad.
The conditional period for the RM160 million acquisition of Wisma UniRazak from Permodalan Nasional Berhad was extended by three months to 19 February 2027.
The company launched an A$1.08 billion mixed-use project in Melbourne and is reportedly considering a REIT listing by 2028.
risks_en: The company had a winding-up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator announcement (No. 5), but no specific details were provided.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between October and November 2026, indicating changes in major shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,160.6 million, up 45.2% QoQ and 9.3% YoY; net income was RM322.0 million, up 102.8% QoQ and 124.4% YoY; net margin was 27.7%, higher than 19.9% in the previous quarter.
